This image has been going around on voat the past few days. The main problem with it is that it is talking about the wrong law. The anon claims that under Title II of the Telecommunications Act of 1996, ISPs would have to get a broadcast license from the FCC in order to operate. That much is true. Broadcast licenses are necessary for wireless communication because there is a finite amount of electromagnetic spectrum to go around. Without a licensing scheme, the radio waves would be so cluttered they would be unusable.

 

However, Broadband internet was reclaassified a broadcast service, the businesses regulated by that law. They were ruled common carriers under TITLE II OF THE TELECOMMUNICATIONS ACT OF 1934. This is a completely different thing. A common carrier can't discriminate between customers. FedEx can't refuse service to your business because they don't like you. Railroads have to ship whatever a customer pays them to, even hazardous materials, as long as it is feasible. If anything, ISPs being common carriers would strengthen free speech on the internet. Remember how people got the Daily Stormer removed from DNS directories? It would totally be possible now for people to complain to ISPs for allowing voat to use their networks to spread hate and get us blacklisted.

 

Nothing bothers me more than disinformation, so I really wanted to clear this up.
PSA: That 4chan post about Net Neutrality is WRONG. The image is referring to the wrong law. ISPs would not have to get broadcast licenses to stay in business.

I’d add another one to your list. Speed and distance in space. At the beginning, they clearly say that the rebel ships are faster. What does this mean, who the fuck knows, because the writer has never read even a Wikipedia article on space propulsion. If you make the assumption that the ships are burning liquid fuel, then we can assume the rockets on the rebel ships have better thrust and can reach higher speeds faster (distinguished from the FTL drives). An object moving in open space encounters no friction, which means it’s speed is actually exponential. This is not a race between a car that’s going 30 MPH and one that’s going 50MPH steadily, it’s one that starts at 30 vs 50 where the relative speed of the 50 MPH car gets increasingly faster. The bad ship (can’t even remember what they called the stupid thing) is going to fall further and further behind. And even when the Rebel ships run out of fuel, they’re going to continue at that same speed, not stop and float off. It’s SO fucking stupid.

As to Leia, it’s estimated that a human can survive maybe 15-30 of exposure to the vacuum of space. So it’s conceivable that if she was able to react instantly, and her life was in danger, her latent Force powers might be able to save her.
